question: ‘The Diary of a Young Girl’ is an autobiography of ______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anne Frank**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anne Frank was a German poet who wrote diaries like Tales From the Secret Annex and Diary of A Young Girl. 
 
• The story of Anne Frank is among the most well-known of the 6 million Jews who died in the Holocaust.
 
• Her diary is the first encounter many people have with the history of Nazi Germany's attempt to murder all the Jews of Europe during World War II.
